title: What dashboard Stop chain does to anti-rug monitoring

options.name: Keep current behaviour: Stop removes every listener on ctx.wsProvider (the anti-rug filter included) and Start does not restore it
options.risk: After Stop and Start, open positions on the chain have no rug protection until the next buy or socket drop, while the badge shows connected (AUD-ANTIRUG-001).

options.name: Stop removes only the factory listeners; anti-rug keeps monitoring open positions
options.risk: An operator who wanted everything quiet on the chain still gets anti-rug exits.

options.name: Stop removes everything, shows "anti-rug OFF" on the dashboard, and Start re-subscribes anti-rug
options.behavior_impact: Stop is a full stop with a visible protection state.
options.risk: Positions are unprotected while stopped, by operator choice.

recommendation: stop-keeps-antirug, implemented through the single WebSocket owner (OD-11).
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether stopping a chain also stops rug protection for its open positions.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
